# dependency_pin_observation

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Compares a declared dependency ref with its immutable resolved commit.

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |

| `observed_at` | `datetime` | yes | Timestamp of resolution. |
